newsitem.title: UK: Ghana cocoa purchases total 20,052 T in 3rd week.
newsitem.headline: Ghana cocoa purchases total 20,052 T in 3rd week.

text.p: Ghana cocoa purchases in the third week of the 1996/97 marketing season ending October 31 totalled 20,052 tonnes compared with 19,349 tonnes in the week ending October 26 1995, the Ghana Cocoa Board said on Friday.
Purchases at the end of the third week were a total 75,192 tonnes compared with 65,587 tonnes, it said.
In the 1995/96 season cocoa purchases totalled 87,520 tonnes at the end of the week ending November 2 with the weekly figure at 21,933 tonnes.
